name: Game Vertical Slice
description: Prove the game loop in a small representative slice before manufacturing a continent of content nobody wants.

tasks.name: Define player fantasy and pillars
tasks.objective: State the player fantasy, core verbs, target emotional loop, audience, platform constraints, differentiators, and explicit non-goals.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each design pillar constrains actual mechanics or content decisions.

tasks.name: Prototype core loop
tasks.objective: Build the smallest playable loop that tests the risky mechanics, controls, feedback, fail/retry cycle, and progression assumption. Use placeholder assets where polish would hide design truth.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The core loop is playable end-to-end without production art.
Known risks are observable in the prototype.

tasks.name: Design representative slice
tasks.objective: Choose one bounded segment that demonstrates final-quality interaction, encounter/content structure, art direction, UI, audio, and performance targets without pretending to be the whole game.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every slice feature proves a production assumption needed for the larger game.

tasks.name: Instrument and playtest
tasks.objective: Capture completion, failure points, time-on-task, confusion, control errors, strategy diversity, qualitative reactions, and observer notes. Do not coach testers past unclear design.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Observed behavior is separated from tester opinion and designer interpretation.

tasks.name: Iterate highest-risk failures
tasks.objective: Rank problems by damage to the player fantasy and uncertainty reduction. Fix mechanics and feedback before adding content. Re-test material changes with comparable scenarios.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each iteration targets an observed failure or unresolved design risk.

tasks.name: Package production proof
tasks.objective: Deliver the playable slice, design decisions, asset/style bible, technical constraints, measured playtest findings, unresolved risks, content-production estimates, and a kill/change/continue recommendation for each unproven assumption.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The slice exposes remaining production risk instead of disguising it with polish.
